result.description: A fictional 27-inch desktop monitor built for color-critical illustration and studio preview work. The Lumen Arc 27Q Canvas Display features a matte 2560 x 1440 panel, USB-C connectivity with display input, and a simple anti-glare frame intended for mixed creative and office environments. It is positioned as a mid-range general-purpose display rather than a gaming or storage device, with emphasis on comfort, clarity, and workstation compatibility.
